# Andrew T. Rodriguez

> Ph.D. Scientist in Aging Biology and AI Training Data

## About

Andrew T. Rodriguez is a Ph.D.-trained scientist in the Biology of Aging, with expertise in autophagy, neuroendocrine signaling, and organismal stress resilience. He builds and quality-checks reinforcement learning (RL) and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data that trains frontier AI models to reason about biology, as a contractor with Sieve and Handshake AI, and builds public evaluations of how models reason about aging biology. He is pursuing biotech roles and strategic project and operations roles at companies building scientific AI training data and evaluations.

## Education

- Ph.D., Biology of Aging: Buck Institute for Research on Aging & University of Southern California (2025)
- M.S., Biochemistry & Molecular Biology: UC Santa Barbara (2016)
- B.S., Bioengineering: Stanford University (2015)

## Experience

- QC Auditor, Biology (Oct 2026-present): Handshake AI; final biology-specialist reviewer of RL tasks in a project's approval pipeline
- Ph.D. Domain Expert, AI Model Evaluation (Biology) (2026-present): Handshake AI; RL rollout review and RL task design for frontier AI labs
- Applied AI Research Contractor (2026-present): Sieve; RL task environments, grading rubrics, and multimodal SFT data for scientific image analysis; one of four biology experts advising a client research team on training data strategy
- Ph.D. Research Scientist, Biology of Aging (2020-2025): Buck Institute & USC, Garrison Lab
- Staff Research Associate II, Stem Cell Aging (2019-2020): UCSF, Brack Lab
- Research Associate II, Radiation Toxicology R&D (2017-2019): Varian Medical Systems (now Siemens Healthineers)

## Key Research

- Discovered a novel role for neuropeptide signaling in regulating autophagy and stress resilience in C. elegans (first-author manuscript in preparation)
- Built an RNA-seq differential expression and pathway enrichment pipeline in R and Linux
- Demonstrated tissue-specific, age-dependent regulation of autophagy and HSF-1 activation

## Projects

- Aging Biology Evals (https://lifespan.andrewtrodriguez.com): 1,379-gene GenAge evaluation of Claude Sonnet 4.6; found a directional bias (73% recall on pro-longevity vs 30% on anti-longevity genes); LLM grader validated against expert hand-grading (Cohen's kappa = 0.79)

## Skills

- AI Training Data & Evaluation: RL task, rubric, and SFT data design, QC auditing, agent trajectory review, LLM-as-judge validation, Claude & Claude Code (daily)
- Computation: Python, R, MATLAB, Linux
- Bioinformatics: RNA-seq (STAR, DESeq2, clusterProfiler), pathway enrichment, survival analysis
- Wet Lab: C. elegans genetics, mammalian cell culture, flow cytometry, CRISPR/Cas9
- Imaging: Confocal microscopy (Zeiss LSM980 Airyscan), 3D segmentation
